title: Making Money Online is Easy, Actually (Just Copy Me)
summary: A creator pitches e-commerce with an AI store builder and a sponsored fulfilment tool, blaming side-hustle failure on lack of commitment.

assertions.quote: It's almost never your side hustle that's flawed or doesn't work, you are most likely just not putting enough time and effort in.
you'll never get anywhere by jumping from one to the other
you can now use a free tool called buildyourstore.ai to launch a fully automated store
This means you don't have to touch inventory, package anything, or deal with supply negotiations.
You can easily create a buzz around your products by creating videos about 'em on TikTok for free.
relying on a single paycheck is more dangerous than ever
As soon as you start making money, put a small portion back into your side hustle.

verdicts.note: Reinvesting is needed to grow, but it cannot fix a business with no demand, and crediting top earners' success to it is survivorship bias.
